retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-style interior portrait featuring a central subject on a bed, framed by oversized top-aligned serif typography and a diagonal black-bar subtitle.
excludeWhen: modern digital clean photography is required
bright neon color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic, low-saturation photograph of a woman in a slip kneeling on a bed, characterized by a soft, warm interior glow, framed by massive white serif lettering at the top and a tilted black banner across the middle-right.
coreVisualRelationships: Oversized header text bleeding off the top edge
Subject centered vertically beneath the main title
Diagonal black bar providing a sharp geometric contrast to soft bedding
Muted beige and cream tones punctuated by small red accents
coreInvariants: Soft-focus background with domestic props (lamp, bottle, flowers)
Analog film texture with visible grain and slight desaturation

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, medium-full shot, kneeling on a bed, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white serif letters at the top edge act as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top header down to the subject's face, then following the diagonal black bar to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space provided by the plain wall behind the subject and the white bedding.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value in the background; high contrast in the typography.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are cropped at the top edge of the frame
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniform serif family used in two scales and contexts (header vs. label).
graphicDevices: Solid black rectangular bar with a slight upward tilt

preserve: High contrast between thick and thin strokes

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme contrast and verticality of the header.
Provides the elegant, high-fashion 70s look for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s film-style photograph of a woman in a silk slip kneeling on a messy white bed in a beige room. Include a vintage bedside lamp, a small vase of red roses, and a green bottle on a wooden table in the background. Use soft, warm lighting and visible film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a massive white uppercase serif title at the very top, cropped by the frame edge. Add a solid black horizontal bar tilted slightly upward on the right side, containing white uppercase serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the top text cropped by the upper border?
Is the black bar tilted at a slight angle?
Does the image have a warm, muted 70s color grade?
Is the font a high-contrast Didone style?

adjustableVariables: Tilt angle of the black bar
mustRedesign: Do not use lowercase for the display text
Ensure the black bar is not perfectly horizontal
postGenerationChecks: Verify the top-edge bleed of the header
Ensure the color palette remains in the beige/cream spectrum
Confirm the presence of the diagonal black graphic element
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a grainy, low-saturation interior portrait with oversized, top-cropped Didone typography and a tilted geometric label for a 1970s editorial aesthetic.
